# FreePDFHub

> Free browser-based PDF tools: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, protect and more. All processing runs client-side in the browser, so files never leave the user's device. No signup, no watermarks, no limits.

FreePDFHub is an independent, ad-supported suite of 28 PDF utilities. Every tool uses WebAssembly and JavaScript (pdf-lib, mupdf, pdfjs-dist) to process documents locally in the browser. There are no accounts, no server-side file storage, and the site works offline as an installable PWA.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Directory of all 28 free PDF tools, grouped by category.
- [About](/about): Who builds FreePDFHub and the privacy-first philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the team.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): What data is (and isn't) collected.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use.

## Organize PDF

- [Merge PDF](/tools/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into one document in a chosen order.
- [Split PDF](/tools/split): Separate one PDF into multiple files or extract page ranges.
- [Compress PDF](/tools/compress): Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality.
- [Delete Pages](/tools/delete-pages): Remove unwanted pages from a PDF.
- [Extract Pages](/tools/extract-pages): Save selected pages as a new PDF.
- [Reorder Pages](/tools/reorder-pages): Drag and drop pages to rearrange a PDF.
- [Add Blank Pages](/tools/add-blank-pages): Insert empty pages anywhere in a PDF.
- [Rotate PDF](/tools/rotate): Rotate pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

## Convert PDF

- [Image to PDF](/tools/images-to-pdf): Convert JPG and PNG images to a PDF.
- [PDF to Image](/tools/pdf-to-images): Export each PDF page as a JPG or PNG.
- [Extract Images](/tools/extract-images): Pull all embedded images out of a PDF.
- [PDF to Text](/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract all text from a PDF as .txt.
- [TXT to PDF](/tools/txt-to-pdf): Convert a plain text file into a PDF.
- [Scan to PDF](/tools/scan-to-pdf): Use the device camera to scan documents into a PDF.

## Edit PDF

- [Edit & Annotate PDF](/tools/edit-pdf): Edit existing text, highlight, add comments, shapes, images, and freehand drawings.
- [Page Numbers](/tools/page-numbers): Add page numbers with custom position and style.
- [Add Header & Footer](/tools/header-footer): Stamp dates, filenames, or company text on every page.
- [Add Watermark](/tools/watermark): Stamp text or an image over a PDF with adjustable opacity.
- [Crop PDF](/tools/crop): Trim margins and adjust the visible area of every page.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](/tools/pdf-metadata): View and edit PDF title, author, subject, and keywords.
- [Grayscale PDF](/tools/grayscale-pdf): Convert a PDF to black and white for cleaner printing.

## Forms & Compare

- [Fill PDF Forms](/tools/fill-forms): Fill in interactive PDF form fields.
- [Flatten PDF](/tools/flatten-pdf): Make form fields and annotations permanent.
- [Sign PDF](/tools/sign-pdf): Create an electronic signature and place it on a PDF.
- [Compare PDFs](/tools/compare): Side-by-side visual and text diff of two PDFs.

## Security

- [Protect PDF](/tools/protect-pdf): Add a password and encrypt a PDF.
- [Redact PDF](/tools/redact-pdf): Permanently remove sensitive text and images.
- [Unlock PDF](/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove a known password from a PDF.

## Image Tools

- [Image Tools Hub](/image-tools): Browser-based image converters and utilities.
- [HEIC to JPG](/image-tools/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG in the browser. Batch + ZIP download.
- [HEIC to PNG](/image-tools/heic-to-png): Convert iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to lossless PNG in the browser. Batch + ZIP download.
- [JPG to PNG](/image-tools/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG/JPEG images to lossless PNG in the browser. Batch + ZIP download.
- [PNG to JPG](/image-tools/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG images to smaller JPG files in the browser. Adjustable quality, batch + ZIP download.
- [WebP to JPG](/image-tools/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images to universal JPG files in the browser. Adjustable quality, batch + ZIP download.
- [WebP to PNG](/image-tools/webp-to-png): Convert WebP images to lossless PNG in the browser with transparency preserved. Batch + ZIP download.
- [Compress Image](/image-tools/compress-image): Reduce JPG, PNG, and WebP file size in the browser. Quality slider or target size in KB (100KB, 200KB, 50KB). Batch + ZIP download.
- [Resize Image](/image-tools/image-resize): Resize JPG, PNG, and WebP by exact pixels or percent in the browser. Presets for passport photo (413x531), signature (140x60), 720p, and 1080p. Optional KB target. Batch + ZIP.
- [JPG to WebP](/image-tools/jpg-to-webp): Convert JPG/JPEG to modern WebP in the browser. Adjustable quality, WASM fallback on Safari so output is always a real .webp. Batch + ZIP download.
- [PNG to WebP](/image-tools/png-to-webp): Convert PNG to modern WebP in the browser with transparency preserved (alpha carries over). Adjustable quality, WASM fallback on Safari. Batch + ZIP download.

- [Crop Image](/image-tools/crop-image): Crop JPG, PNG, and WebP to any size in the browser. Interactive crop box with drag+resize handles, aspect presets (1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, Passport 35x45), and exact pixel inputs. Batch + ZIP.
- [Rotate and Flip Image](/image-tools/rotate-image): Rotate JPG, PNG, and WebP by 90/180/270 degrees, or mirror/flip vertically in the browser. Cumulative actions, Apply to all, batch + ZIP.
- [Add Watermark to Image](/image-tools/watermark-image): Add a text or logo watermark to JPG, PNG, and WebP in the browser. 9-cell position grid, tile mode, opacity, rotation, batch + ZIP.
